moves.label: Ncha Quick Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab with a tiny robot poke and a short active window.
moves.reason: Very compact standing hand poke.

moves.label: Low Robot Slide
moves.description: Fast low slide that sends Arale skimming forward for long active pressure.
moves.reason: Frames show a low horizontal body slide.

moves.label: Windup Robot Hook
moves.description: Quick mid hook with a cartoon windup and compact recovery.
moves.reason: Small body turns into a mid-height hook effect.

moves.label: Gatchan Flip Kick
moves.description: Fast mid flip kick that stays active through Arale's tumbling recovery.
moves.reason: The move flips through multiple airborne-looking frames.

moves.label: Penguin Village Link
moves.description: Slow mid link that shoulder-checks forward before Arale resets.
moves.reason: Short forward body-check sequence with no special visual effect.

moves.label: Robot Spin Launcher
moves.description: Quick mid launcher that spins Arale through a rising cartoon arc.
moves.reason: Rising spin frames clearly read as a pop-up launcher.

moves.label: Low Gadget Feint
moves.description: Fast low feint that ducks under pressure before Arale pops back up.
moves.reason: Low crouched body and low-contact posture.

moves.label: Flying Robot Sweep
moves.description: Steady low knockdown that launches Arale sideways like a tiny missile.
moves.reason: Horizontal flying body frames hit low and end in a fall.

moves.label: Norimaki Power Crash
moves.description: Slow mid knockdown that drives Arale forward with a committed body check.
moves.reason: Heavy forward lunge supports the power-crush role.

moves.label: Crouch Robot Pester
moves.description: Quick mid crouch poke that scoots forward with playful pressure.
moves.reason: Full-crouch route shows low stance and compact poking frames.

moves.label: Crouch Spin Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher that rises from crouch into a spinning hit.
moves.reason: Crouch route transitions into the same spin-pop visual language.

moves.label: Charged Ncha Jab
moves.description: Fast high charged poke with a simple short active strike.
moves.reason: Charge command reuses Arale's quick jab silhouette.

moves.label: Robot Aura Bonk
moves.description: Quick special knockdown that spins Arale into a long active bonk.
moves.reason: Charge command and knockdown role fit the powered cartoon spin.

moves.label: While-Rising Hook
moves.description: Quick mid while-standing hook with a short active window.
moves.reason: While-standing route uses the mid hook frames.

moves.label: Rising Robot Tumble
moves.description: Quick mid rising tumble that carries Arale upward through active frames.
moves.reason: The sequence rises and tumbles with clear airborne movement.

moves.label: Low-Step Ncha Jab
moves.description: Fast high poke from a low command that still strikes at head height.
moves.reason: The contact frames match the high jab silhouette.

moves.label: Forward Spin Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher that steps forward into Arale's spinning hit.
moves.reason: d/f route uses the spin launcher frames.

moves.label: Forward Robot Poke
moves.description: Slow mid forward poke that trades speed for a committed step-in hit.
moves.reason: Forward route is a small advancing body poke.

moves.label: Forward Robot Hook
moves.description: Quick mid forward hook with compact active timing.
moves.reason: Forward command reuses the mid hook animation.

moves.label: Ncha Dash Jab
moves.description: Fast high motion jab with quick startup and tiny recovery.
moves.reason: Motion command uses the same quick jab contact frames.

moves.label: Penguin Village Burst
moves.description: Fast mid knockdown that bursts through a tumbling robot strike.
moves.reason: The finisher tumbles into a heavy cartoon knockdown.
